description: This file contains unit tests for credits utility functions and related data normalization, testing functions like 'usdToCredits' and 'getCreditsPerUsd', as well as verifying credits field normalization in project/user objects.

methods.name: getCreditsPerUsd
methods.description: Returns the number of credits per USD, defaulting to 20000 if environment variable is unset.

methods.name: usdToCredits
methods.description: Converts a USD amount to credits based on the current conversion rate, returning 0 for invalid inputs.
